component.name: InnerPod
component.summary: A session timer with private logging to your Solid Pod

description.p: InnerPod is a session timer, typically used for silent meditation. Choose a length and a bell, and the bell marks the start and the end of the session. A guided session is also available.
Sessions can be logged, encrypted, to your own Solid Pod, so nobody, not even the server administrator, can see them. Without a login the timer simply runs and nothing is sent anywhere.
